reviews.title: Used to love this app
reviews.text: Now, it will show me a partial update on a banner, but when I open the app to read it, I get a blank screen.

reviews.title: Missing rural cities!
reviews.text: And need a way to customize which alerts I want.

reviews.title: Needs dark mode
reviews.text: Open this during a blackout and that bright white background will be a shock to the retinas.  Also, a dark background can offer some battery savings so it’s logical to implement a dark mode. The Environment Canada app has dark mode. Why doesn’t FEMA?

reviews.title: Keeps crashing
reviews.text:
I have had this app on my phone for a long time and always appreciated the warnings
However, this version keeps crashing and going blank
Since I am currently under an active tornado watch it’s frustrating and scary

reviews.title: All Notifications All the Time
reviews.text: This app is great for weather alerts.  However, even if I turn certain alerts off, they still come through. I get inundated with way too many notifications that I quit paying attention. Definitely not ideal for an emergency application. Just show me tornados. 🙄🌪️

reviews.title: Bug that has been happening for several months. New update does not fix.
reviews.text: I get notifications about alerts but they do not show up in the app, so I can’t see the actual contents of the alerts.

reviews.title: Late alerts
reviews.text: Storm had passed. Alert says hail 10pm but not visible on radar

reviews.title: Where did the alerts go?
reviews.text: Help! In Alaska, where weather can change several times a day, I’ve always depended on FEMA alerts for details on what to expect. But lately when I get notifications of events such as “severe weather warning” and I open the app, I’m told there are “no active alerts.” How can I get essential details on these weather warnings?

reviews.title: Previously useful - now a potential waste.
reviews.text: This app was something I used for situation awareness, however it has dramatically changed recently.  Alerts are now received, however when the app is opened to review the entire alert - the home page shows no related detail information.  It is unfortunate that this previously useful tool is now lacking.

reviews.title: Nonstop alerts
reviews.text: It sends you an alert. Then it sends you another alert. And then it sends you dozens of more alerts, without any discernible change in information. Which should be a very useful app is nothing but a continuous annoyance because of the developers, inability to control the number of unique alerts that are sent out.

reviews.title: Not seeing Alerts in app
reviews.text: Got a notice about fire weather warnings but when I opened the app to get the details there is no information. This has been happening for several weeks with snow and wind warnings. Still has other good resources and advice in the app for preparation but no longer much of an emergency notification app.

reviews.title: Stopped working
reviews.text: Until recently, this was a very unusual app. Unfortunately, it stopped working. I still get pop up notifications. However, when I open the app there are no alerts for my location and so no details.
